cases.question: ¿Qué facturas de compra activas tienen saldo pendiente en febrero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS saldo_pendiente FROM purchase_invoice pi JOIN supplier s ON s.id = pi.supplier_id LEFT JOIN purchase_payment pp ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY s.id, s.business_name, pi.id, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount HAVING pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) > 0 ORDER BY saldo_pendiente DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT pi.id AS id, pi.series AS series, pi.number AS number, pi.total_amount AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS pagos, (pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0)) AS saldo_pendiente FROM public.purchase_invoice AS pi LEFT JOIN public.purchase_payment AS pp ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE) AND pi.issued_at < CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY pi.id, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount HAVING (pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0)) > 0 LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el total de egresos de caja en febrero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cm.amount), 0) AS total FROM cash_movement cm WHERE cm.type = 'EXPENSE' AND cm.created_at >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND cm.created_at < DATE '2026-03-01' LIMIT 50

cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cm.amount), 0) AS total FROM cash_movement cm WHERE cm.type = 'INCOME' AND cm.created_at >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND cm.created_at < DATE '2026-03-01' LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántas sesiones cerradas tuvo cada caja en febrero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, COUNT(*) AS sesiones FROM cash_session cs JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY sesiones DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se registró en ventas en efectivo y otros medios por caja en febrero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, SUM(cs.sales_cash) AS ventas_efectivo, SUM(cs.sales_other) AS ventas_otros FROM cash_session cs JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY caja LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, COALESCE(SUM(cs.sales_cash), 0) AS ventas_efectivo, COALESCE(SUM(cs.sales_other), 0) AS ventas_otros FROM public.cash_session AS cs JOIN public.cash_register AS cr ON cs.cash_register_id = cr.id WHERE cs.opened_at >= CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE) AND cs.opened_at < CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY cr.name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue la diferencia total de las sesiones cerradas de caja en febrero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cs.difference), 0) AS diferencia FROM cash_session cs WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-03-01' LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto dinero se movió por tipo de movimiento de caja en febrero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cm.type, SUM(cm.amount) AS total FROM cash_movement cm WHERE cm.created_at >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND cm.created_at < DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY cm.type ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se egresó por caja registradora en febrero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, SUM(cm.amount) AS egresos FROM cash_movement cm JOIN cash_session cs ON cs.id = cm.session_id JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cm.type = 'EXPENSE' AND cm.created_at >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND cm.created_at < DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY egresos DESC LIMIT 50
